proposal.title: Vynaezor: a framework for signed and rollback-proof updates
proposal.summary: Vynaezor builds a framework for signed and rollback-proof updates for vendors of small appliances.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Update channels are a common way to compromise many devices at once. Vendors of small appliances depend on software update security every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build a framework for signed and rollback-proof updates called Vynaezor. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/vynaezor/vynaezor, which 117 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on software update security for 10 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the Apache-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/vynaezor/vynaezor. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 6 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 4. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 6.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 48900.00 EUR for 73 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 500.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem
Update channels are a common way to compromise many devices at once. Vendors of small appliances depend on software update security every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

Approach
We will build a framework for signed and rollback-proof updates called Vynaezor. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/vynaezor/vynaezor, which 117 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on software update security for 10 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the Apache-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/vynaezor/vynaezor. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 6 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 4. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 6.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 48900.00 EUR for 73 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 500.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.
